g.text: Local angular extrema reveal the critical rays
Both boundaries use the same road station s. Only forward, inward tangencies become cut candidates.
ILLUSTRATIVE GEOMETRY | Smooth embedded road strip; computed events and ray intersections.
Three inward tangencies: T1, T2, T3
At a nondegenerate extremum, the line of sight is tangent.
The other extrema do not pass the inward-event test.
